name: Pieter Botha
bio:
Pieter grew up in the shadow of the Kyalami Grand Prix Circuit, sparking a lifelong passion for motorsport. He started his career as a general mechanic, working on everything from family sedans to bakkies. Eventually, he found his niche in fabrication, drawn to the precision and problem-solving involved in crafting bespoke parts. Pieter's approach is methodical and thorough, favoring practical solutions over flashy designs. 

While he's relatively new to the high-stakes world of professional racing, Pieter's decades of experience in the automotive industry have instilled in him a deep understanding of materials, processes, and the importance of reliability. His calm demeanor and unwavering commitment to quality make him a valuable asset, ready to learn and contribute to a winning team. He's particularly adept at TIG welding and enjoys the challenge of recreating rare or obsolete parts.

physical.description: A solidly built man with weathered hands and a kind smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of whistling Afrikaans folk tunes while working.
Refuses to work without a strong cup of rooibos tea.
